info.title: Pidgen Public API: pending worker enrollment routes
info.description: The worker install id and withdrawing an enrollment, as the App Service states them. POST /api/v1/workers/enrollments and GET /api/v1/workers are published; they are held here as published plus `install_id` (optional, 32 lowercase hex characters) on CreateEnrollmentRequest, CreatedEnrollment and WorkerResource, because the published CreateEnrollmentRequest refuses unknown fields. GET /api/v1/workers/enrollments (the caller's own enrollments, pending only unless `state` widens it) and DELETE /api/v1/workers/enrollments/{enrollment_id} (withdraw one; 404 WORKER_ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND) are not yet published. An enrollment, WorkerEnrollment, has CreatedEnrollment's fields without token, install_commands, install and eula. When the server publishes them, they are pulled with contracts/openapi.json and this file is deleted. Settled here where the stated contract is silent: the schema names, `all` for `state`, and the enrollment list's order. Every route takes the bearer credential and the X-PIDGEN-Account header like the published routes.

get.description: List the workers enrolled in the Account named by X-PIDGEN-Account: host, locality, whether this API process holds its channel, when it was last seen, the major.minor protocol it last announced and where that stands against this service (protocol_state), and per Project remote whether it last reported a local git credential. Also its name, who enrolled it, whether it is the Account fleet's, its scope and credential mode, and its latest preflight (tools, coding-agent CLIs, their login and repository access). mine=true lists only the workers you enrolled. Owners and Administrators (account.manage_workers) see every worker; a member who may enroll their own workers (account.enroll_own_workers) sees only theirs. No Personal API Token scope reaches it. Each worker names the install_id its enrollment was created with.

422.description: INPUT_INVALID: the request failed validation; error.details.errors lists each failure (loc, msg, type).

default.description: An error, in the public error shape.

post.description: Create a one-time enrollment token (valid 24 hours) in the request's Account and return it once, with the install options for each published form of the worker and the end-user licence agreement it ships under. Run an option's `install`, then its `enroll`, on the machine the worker will run on. `display_name` is required; `fleet` true enrolls a worker for the Account fleet (Owners and Administrators), false a machine you manage (members too, while the Account allows it); `scope` sets whom it serves. A Personal API Token needs the workers:enroll scope. Counts against the Account's max_enrolled_workers (403 ENTITLEMENT_LIMIT_REACHED). `install_id` (optional) names the worker install the enrollment is for; the caller's earlier pending enrollment for the same install is withdrawn when this one is created. A server that does not take install_id yet refuses it with 422 INPUT_INVALID naming the field.

install_commands.wheel: uv tool install pidgen-worker~=1.0.0 && pidgen-worker enroll --token pidgen_enroll_example_one_time_token

install.command: uv tool install pidgen-worker~=1.0.0 && pidgen-worker enroll --token pidgen_enroll_example_one_time_token

delete.description: Withdraw one of the caller's own pending worker enrollments: it is revoked, its token can no longer be exchanged, and it stops counting against the Account's workers. Answers the enrollment. An enrollment that is not the caller's, or not in this Account, is 404 WORKER_ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND.

PreflightHarness.title: PreflightHarness
PreflightHarness.description:
One coding-agent CLI the node configuration enables.

Attributes:
    harness: The harness (``claude``, ``codex``, ...).
    cli_present: Whether its CLI resolves.
    version: The CLI's version, or ``None`` when absent or illegible.
    login: Its adapter's credential-readiness check; no credential is reported.
    subscriptions: Each subscription the worker holds for it, in preference order, the
        first being the primary. Empty from a worker that reports none, which holds one
        ``unattributed`` subscription, ``default``.
    live_steering: Whether the adapter takes instructions after its run has started,
        sent from protocol minor 9; ``None`` from a node that did not say. Recorded,
        not acted on here: the registry's own capability decides.

PreflightRepository.title: PreflightRepository
PreflightRepository.description:
Whether the worker reached one probe target, and in which form.

Attributes:
    project_id: The Project whose remote the App Service named as a probe target.
    reached: Whether ``git ls-remote`` with the machine's own credentials reached it in
        either form.
    form: The form that worked, ``ssh`` or ``https``; ``None`` exactly when neither did.

PreflightSubscription.title: PreflightSubscription
PreflightSubscription.description:
One provider subscription a worker holds for a harness.

Attributes:
    label: The subscription's name in the worker's node configuration.
    fingerprint: A SHA-256 over the provider's own stable account identifier, never a
        token; ``unattributed`` when the worker could not read one. Two workers logged
        into one provider account report one fingerprint and share its limits.
    login: That subscription's credential-readiness check, or ``duplicate`` (from
        protocol minor 2.10) when an earlier subscription of the harness is logged into
        the same provider account and so shares its limit.

PreflightTool.title: PreflightTool
PreflightTool.description:
One required base tool, as the worker found it on its own machine.

Attributes:
    name: The tool (``git``, ``uv``, ...).
    present: Whether it resolves on the worker's ``PATH``.
    version: The version it reported, or ``None`` when absent or illegible.
    meets_floor: Whether that version meets the worker's floor for it.
